page: Microsoft Azure EC8ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECadsv6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and features an AMD processor with 8 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. This resource density is designed to accommodate memory-intensive workloads that require substantial RAM relative to compute capacity.

For storage, the EC8ads_v6 is equipped with 307 GB of local disk storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-speed persistent disk options. The virtualization layer is managed via Microsoft Hyper-V. Tradeoffs of this configuration include the absence of dedicated GPU hardware and the lack of complimentary public IPv4 addresses, meaning external networking must be configured separately.

Given its high memory density of 8.0 GB per core and local storage capabilities, this server is structured for database hosting, in-memory caching, and data processing tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high RAM-to-vCPU ratio provide a balanced profile for enterprise applications requiring stable memory performance without the overhead of a GPU.
